call_points.text: No numeric revenue or margin guidance given; management calls the raw material cost spike transitory.
Expects to commission 300,000+ sq. ft. of operational area at the ~50+ acre greenfield project by end of Q2FY27.
Reynolds asset purchase is underway: team integration done and asset transfer to Umbergaon undertaken; full sales potential comes over time.
Domestic demand buoyancy sustained, supported by the onset of the back-to-school season.
First phase construction on the ~45-acre land parcel is nearing completion, with commercial production expected by the end of Q2 FY27.
Managed raw material cost volatility and supply chain disruptions from the West Asia crisis through prudent sourcing.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹3.65 per share, aggregating to ~10% of standalone PAT.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Ld. Assessing Officer had passed a Rectification Order for Assessment Year 2020-21 (Financial Year 2019-2020), under Section 154 read with Section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 ('the Act') and issued a Notice of Demand under Section 156 of the Act wherein the officer has disallowed benefit of concessional rate of tax @ 22% u/s 115BAA. The Company has filed an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) against the said assessment order.

operating_notes.text: Crisil Ratings monitoring report notes ₹329.08 Cr utilized out of ₹332.72 Cr net IPO proceeds up to March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 revenue reached ₹604.0 Cr (+18.7% YoY) and FY26 revenue reached ₹2,326.4 Cr (+21.6% YoY).
Received customs appeal final order for ₹0.13 Cr differential GST, ₹0.13 Cr penalty, and ₹0.20 Cr redemption fine.
Raw material basket experienced peak inflation of 15% to 20% due to West Asia conflict, while price hikes taken so far are 4% to 5%.
Q1FY27 gross product sales were ₹693.2 Cr, of which exports were 12.0% and India 85.6%.
Domestic distribution covers 6,250+ distributors, 1,45,000+ retail outlets and 1,100+ sales personnel as of June 30, 2026.
The ~50+ acre greenfield project is expected to commission 300,000+ sq. ft. of operational area by the end of Q2FY27.
Incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named DOMS Seven Private Limited with a cash consideration of ₹1,00,000.

timeline.summary: DOMS Industries released the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 on May 12, 2026, showing ₹329.08 Cr utilized from IPO proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹603.98 Cr (+18.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹56.74 Cr (+17.1% YoY).
DOMS Industries released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, reporting revenue of ₹604.0 Cr for Q4 (+18.7% YoY) and ₹2,326.4 Cr for FY26.
DOMS Industries Limited held an Investor/Analyst Conference Call on May 19, 2026, discussing audited FY2026 results, with audio available at the company website.
DOMS Industries received a customs appeal final order on May 19, 2026, upholding a ₹0.47 Cr total duty, penalty, and fine demand.
DOMS Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹603.98 Cr (+18.7% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹2,326.4 Cr (+21.6% YoY).
Q1FY27 (Aug 2026): revenue rose 19.2% YoY to ₹670.5 Cr but EBITDA fell 16.4% to ₹82.6 Cr and PAT 23.4% to ₹45.3 Cr as gross margin dropped to 38.2% on raw material inflation.
DOMS Industries incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, DOMS Seven Private Limited, on October 22, 2026, with an investment of ₹1 lakh.
